tx:
Burning lines of cheap logs, such as teak logs (), is an effective way of obtaining large amounts of ashes. Tarromin incense sticks allow automatic banking of ashes from fires.
Killing Hell-Rats in the Basement of Doom or mummies in Ullek rewards ashes for each kill, which can potentially be faster than log burning.
For players with a decent combat level, killing enemies in the Abyss can also be a quick way to acquire large numbers of ashes, since the enemies drop ashes upon death. A charming imp is indirectly helpful in the Abyss, as the creatures drop non-stackable abyssal charms frequently; if the imp is not used to auto-destroy them, the excessive amount of drops would prevent ashes from being picked up via area loot.
If you have completed at least the easy Underworld achievements, the Underworld Grimoire's worn effect sends picked-up ashes to the bank automatically; the grimoire also allows you to pick up ashes even when your bag is full. Using the Underworld Grimoire in combination with picking up glowing fungus or killing monsters in the Abyss is one of the fastest ways to collect ashes.
Ashes can also be collected with magic notepaper, enchanted notepaper, or porters, but this is not as simple or cost-effective as the Underworld Grimoire.

▸ Members
• They are used in the quests Shades of Mort'ton and Desert Treasure.
• They are used to make Serum 207.
• They are used with a Fruit Blast to make a dirty blast for the subquest Recipe for Disaster: Another Cook's Quest.
• They are used as food for the phoenix eggling and the abyssal minion.
• Used with a Phoenix scroll (Rise From the Ashes) to activate its special move. (To use the special move, the ashes must be on the ground.)
• Could be requested by Rowdy dwarf during the quest Forgettable Tale of a Drunken Dwarf.
• They are used to make regular ghostly ink, powerful ghostly ink, and greater ghostly ink.
▸ Free-to-play
• They can be crushed with a pestle and mortar to make a ground ashes, awarding the player with 1 Herblore experience (if the level cap hasn't been reached), used to dust the character's hands. This helps when throwing a shotput in the Warriors' Guild for better grip.
